entities.summary: 55 Cancri Ad, formally named Lipperhey, is a candidate extrasolar planet thought to be in a long-period orbit around the Sun-like star 55 Cancri A. If confirmed, it would be at a similar distance from its star as Jupiter is from the Sun, and the fifth and outermost known planet in its planetary system. 55 Cancri Ad was discovered on June 13, 2002.
